comment: The row contract of model §5.2 as a table (task 128 part 1). Read by ui_check_040/row_contract_check.py (the server, through trapper rules) and by lab/php/row_contract_frontend.php (CTopologyType::checkRows). valid_rows: rows that the server keeps; (task 138: no case differs; the frontend keys `frontend` and `reason` are no longer in use)

cases.name: ports-ifindex
cases.why: IFINDEX present (C-120, D-9)

cases.name: ports-ifindex-only
cases.why: IFINDEX is the only required macro

cases.name: ports-snmpindex-fallback
cases.why: SNMPINDEX is the ifIndex of a Port (C-121)

cases.name: ports-ifindex-wins-over-snmpindex
cases.why: both: valid; IFINDEX is the one used

cases.name: ports-empty-ifindex-snmpindex
cases.why: an empty IFINDEX is missing, so the fallback applies (C-124)

cases.name: ports-empty-ifindex
cases.why: an empty IFINDEX counts as missing (C-124)

cases.name: ports-empty-both
cases.why: both empty

cases.name: ports-no-ifindex
cases.why: no IFINDEX and no SNMPINDEX (C-120)

cases.name: ports-no-macros
cases.why: a row with no macro

cases.name: ports-nonnumeric-ifindex
cases.why: the server needs a number; the frontend checks presence only

cases.name: neighbors-ifindex-sysname
cases.why: local ifIndex and remote sysname (C-122)

cases.name: neighbors-locportnum-chassis
cases.why: LLDP local port number and remote chassis

cases.name: neighbors-ifname-only-local
cases.why: a local port name alone is a local port (2.104)

cases.name: neighbors-man-addrs
cases.why: raw management addresses are a remote identity

cases.name: neighbors-snmpindex-no-fallback
cases.why: SNMPINDEX is not an ifIndex of a Neighbor (C-123)

cases.name: neighbors-snmpindex-and-ifindex
cases.why: SNMPINDEX is ignored; IFINDEX is the local port

cases.name: neighbors-no-local-port
cases.why: no local port group

cases.name: neighbors-no-remote
cases.why: no remote identity group

cases.name: neighbors-empty-remote
cases.why: empty remote macros count as missing

cases.name: neighbors-empty-local
cases.why: an empty local macro counts as missing

cases.name: neighbors-none
cases.why: neither group

cases.name: neighbors-nonnumeric-locportnum
cases.why: the server needs a number; the frontend checks presence only

cases.name: device-chassis

cases.why: own CDP device id

cases.name: device-sysname
cases.why: own system name

cases.name: device-none
cases.why: no identity macro

cases.name: device-empty
cases.why: empty identity macros count as missing

cases.name: device-two-rows
cases.why: two valid rows: the server stores an empty snapshot and says "2 rows, one expected" (a rule of the server alone)

cases.name: mixed-rows
